usedFor: Freshsales Classic holds the deals and contacts, and HubSpot receives deals through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Stage Changes” in Freshsales Classic, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A stage change is a clear milestone to mirror, so HubSpot gets a deal when the stage moves.

watchOut: “Deal Stage Changes” is polling and fires on every stage move, so one deal can create several in HubSpot.
